premise.claim: AlluxioFileUtils.MasterPodName() parses `alluxio fsadmin report` output: it reads str[1] after checking len(str) < 1, and data[2] after checking len(data) < 2. When the command succeeds but its output does not have the master address on the second line (empty output, a single line, or `Master Address:` without a value), the function panics with `index out of range` instead of returning the error it was written to return.
premise.evidence: On base 253f6bb8 the contract test panics: `index out of range [1] with length 1` at base.go:487 (str[1] on empty/single-line stdout) and, in a focused run, `index out of range [2] with length 2` at base.go:492 (data[2] on a two-field second line). See results/base-premise-p0-panic.txt.

liveNote: L3 not applicable: the changed function is pure output parsing behind a mocked exec; no cluster-dependent behavior. The only caller is generateDataBackupValueFile (pkg/ddc/alluxio/backup_data.go:57), which propagates the returned error to the DataBackup reconcile.
